messages:
Tess: Quick sync: PR https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4350 updates SDK snippets and fixes a broken cross-ref. We need to land before release cutoff tomorrow 10:00 PT. Who can review?
Omar: I can check the code samples now. Do we have a preview link?
Ben: Preview created: https://preview.redwood.dev/pr-4350 but CI initially failed on linting in `snippets/js.md`. I pushed a quick fix in branch `docs/fix-4350`.
CI-bot: docs-preview build started (job 9542)... build passed. Preview: https://preview.redwood.dev/pr-4350/
Omar: Reviewed JS snippet; changed `client.generate()` to `client.text.generate()` per recent SDK rename. Also added a short migration note. PTAL.
Tess: Thanks. Does this touch versioned docs?
Ben: No, it's under /guides/unified-sdk. No nav changes.
ReleaseOps: Heads-up: cutoff is 10:00 PT, but we require merges by 08:30 PT to allow staging and docs CDN propagation. Can we meet that?
Tess: Yes, aiming to merge by 07:45 PT after approvals.
Omar: Approved from eng. Minor nit fixed in a one-line commit.
Ben: Merged at 07:38 PT into `main`. Commit `c9d8f2`. Starting staging deploy.
CI-bot: staging deploy started for commit c9d8f2.
CI-bot: staging deploy success  smoke tests passed.
ReleaseOps: Great, slot secured. Will watch prod propagation. Closing thread.
